contexts.text: Who shall rouse him up? () = that he is safe in the midst of the internals.
Who am I? () = that he was not yet in such a state.
Who is Jehovah, that I should hear His voice? () = contrary thought about the Lord...
Who will give? () = that it would have been better.
Who has come from Heaven and told us?
Who is like unto the beast? who can make war with him? () = the superiority of that doctrine. ( = that nothing is more true, and that it cannot be impugned. AE 791. AE 792.)
Who does not see the inanity, I will not say the folly, in these things?
